title: Constructible direct-image finiteness condition
statement:
Let $A,I,(P_n)_{n\geq1}$ be the adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]: $A$ is a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I$ is a finitely generated ideal, $A/I$ is torsion as an additive group, and $P_n=A/I^n$ is finite as a set and perfect as an $A$-module for every $n\geq1$. Fix $n\geq1$ and write $\Lambda=P_n$. Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is Noetherian (it has a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings) and finite-dimensional (the Krull dimension of its underlying space [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] is bounded above by a nonnegative integer). Assume the additive order of every element of $\Lambda$ is invertible in every local ring of $T$.

For any scheme $V$, use the coefficient sheaf $\Lambda_{V,\Proet}$ and its module category [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and the comparison morphism $\nu_V:V_{\Proet}\to V_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. A sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda_{V,\Proet}$-modules is called constructible if there is a constructible etale sheaf $F_{\Et}$ of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and a $\Lambda$-linear isomorphism $F\cong\nu_V^*F_{\Et}$. Here etale constructibility uses the finite stratification and finite locally constant restrictions specified in that definition.

Let $u:S\to T$ be a morphism of schemes and fix $c\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$. Use the ordinary finite-coefficient derived direct image $Ru_*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and write
$$R^qu_*F=\mathcal H^q(Ru_*(F[0])),$$
where $F[0]$ is the complex with $F$ in degree zero and zero in other degrees, and $\mathcal H^q$ is the cohomology sheaf [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Define $\mathrm{FIN}(u,\Lambda;c)$ to mean the conjunction of:

1. For every constructible sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda_{S,\Proet}$-modules and every integer $q\geq0$, the sheaf $R^qu_*F$ is constructible on $T_{\Proet}$.
2. For every constructible sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda_{S,\Proet}$-modules and every integer $q>c$, one has $R^qu_*F=0$.

The bound in clause 2 is the specified $c$, independent of $F$. Existence of a bound is expressed separately by $\exists c\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0},\ \mathrm{FIN}(u,\Lambda;c)$. Neither predicate asserts that such a bound exists for every $u$.

blueprint_update.statement:
For the adic coefficient datum, write $\Lambda=P_n=A/I^n$, and assume $T$
noetherian of finite dimension with the orders of the torsion ring $P_n$
invertible on $T$. A sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda_{T,\Proet}$-modules on
$T_{\Proet}$ is *constructible* if $F\cong\nu_T^*F_{\Et}$ for the comparison
morphism of sites [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]
$\nu_T:T_{\Proet}\to T_{\Et}$ and a constructible $\Lambda$-module sheaf
$F_{\Et}$ on $T_{\Et}$. For a morphism $u:S\to T$, write
$\mathrm{FIN}(u,\Lambda;c)$ if:

1. *constructibility of direct images:* for every constructible sheaf $F$ of
   $\Lambda_{S,\Proet}$-modules on $S_{\Proet}$ and every $q\geq0$, the
   sheaf $R^qu_*F$ on $T_{\Proet}$ is constructible;
2. *amplitude:* there is an integer $c\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ such that
   $R^qu_*F=0$ for every $q>c$ and every constructible sheaf $F$ of
   $\Lambda_{S,\Proet}$-modules on $S_{\Proet}$.
